Gene prediction and annotation of the most complete bins with Prokka. Commands for this step were run in `prokka/`.


#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Change direcotry to prokka to find and annotate the genes 

```{bash}
cd prokka
```
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Displays the contents of bbd_topbins.txt located in the ../checkm/ directory, showing the list of selected metagenomic bins.

```{bash}
cat ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
```

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
This command assigns the name metabat.5 to the genome bin and runs Prokka to perform genome annotation on the corresponding FASTA file (metabat.5.fa). It uses 2 CPU cores, saves all annotation results in a directory named metabat.5, and uses the same name as the prefix for the output files.
```{bash}
bin=metabat.5
prokka --cpus 2 --outdir $bin --prefix $bin  ../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa
```

We are lisitng contents of metabat.5
```{bash}
ls metabat.5
```
